text:
sasha: FYI — after the BIOS bump (datacenter-bios-2026-02-17) on rack-12, six GPU nodes' BMCs are dropping into a secure-boot locked state and refusing PXE. Affected: rw-gpu-1201..1206. :warning:
jun: when did the rollout start and which orchestration job?
sasha: started 02:10 UTC via job `fw-rollout-2`. changed BMC and system BIOS at the same time.
maria: monitoring shows OOB heartbeats flapped then came back but no BMC shell/SSH. I see redfish 423 on a couple nodes.
alex: tried curl against rw-gpu-1201 redfish, retrieving SecureBoot endpoint returns status LOCKED and action denied.
sasha: example quick check (no creds here):
```bash
# sample Redfish check (do not paste creds in channel)
curl -k -u admin:REDACTED https://10.0.5.201/redfish/v1/Systems/1/BIOS/SecureBoot -X GET
```
jun: please don't share creds in chat. Steps we can try: ipmitool mc reset, try Redfish Manager->SecureBoot toggle, or revert BMC image. ipmitool example: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.5.201 -U admin mc reset cold`.
maria: note: GPUs (H100s here) require BIOS microcode match. If we start cycling nodes without the GPU microcode update, we risk NVLink failures and kernel panics on resume. Need a careful plan.
alex: my read: BMC accepted the new firmware but secure boot keystore wasn't populated correctly during the migration. So the system flips to locked mode until keys are present; that blocks PXE/remote boot.
sasha: ops-bot, open incident and tag oncall please. we need approval for out-of-band key injection.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-3. Priority: P2. Owner: eng-infra.
jun: cost/impact note: each node counts toward Dedicated reserved capacity. If these 6 nodes stay down for 3 hours that's ~ $120/hr per node — quick math says this is not cheap. Need to minimize time.
maria: proposed immediate plan:
1) pause the rollout globally
2) move affected nodes to maintenance pool (no traffic)
3) attempt key injection/revert to previous BMC on one node as test
4) if successful, roll rest in small batches with validation hooks
5) update orchestration to include keysync step before toggling secure boot
Can we get a maintenance window at 04:00 UTC?
jun: I'll take the first node (rw-gpu-1201) for rollback and key injection test. tagging oncall.
alex: quick manual commands for reference (ops-only):
```bash
# ipmitool reset BMC
ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.5.201 -U admin -P <redacted> mc reset cold
# sample racadm update (Dell iDRAC) - adjust per vendor
racadm fwupdate -g -u /tmp/bmc_fw.bin
# Redfish example to POST secure keys (vendor-specific) - placeholder
curl -k -u admin:REDACTED -X POST https://10.0.5.201/redfish/v1/Managers/1/Actions/Manager.ImportKeys -d '{"KeyBundle":"..."}'
```
sasha: note: security requires key injection via HSM/KMS. ProductSec says keys must be signed and imported with attestation; we cannot just bypass secure boot without trace. We'll coordinate with security.
jun: starting rollback on rw-gpu-1201 now. will update with timestamps and results.
jun: (10m) mc reset succeeded, BMC back, secure-boot still shows LOCKED. attempted Redfish key POST but manager returned 403 — we need HSM token to sign the payload.
maria: check last week's switch ACL changes on mgmt VLAN. There was an ACL change on mgmt-net that might block the orchestration controller from talking to BMC on remote ports 443/623. If controller couldn't push keys earlier, that explains partial state.
alex: I'm on standby for physical console access in case we need serial-over-LAN console. Rack-12 has local tech on call.
sasha: I've created ticket FWN-452 and added the 6 nodes, maintenance window 04:00-06:00 UTC. Also created an automated test to validate secure keys post-inject.
oncall-bot: @jun you are oncall for 04:00 UTC window. Please confirm.
jun: confirmed. I'll work with security to pop the HSM-signed payload.
ops-bot: Noted — change request CR-20260317-9 created for rollback + key injection.
maria: after key injection and verify, do a controlled BIOS reapply to ensure GPU microcode is present (we'll put GPU firmware package in same job).
alex: update from rw-gpu-1201: after HSM-signed key injection (manual step by security), secure-boot shifted to ENABLED and node booted to OS normally. GPU drivers loaded, NVLink OK.
sasha: great. proceed with rolling the remaining 5 nodes in batches of 2 with 10m validation between them. keep maintenance pool and route traffic away.
jun: rolling batch 1 (rw-gpu-1202,rw-gpu-1203). will report every node success/fail.
[...progress updates omitted for channel brevity but logged in CR-20260317-9...]
sasha: post-mortem checklist:
- add keysync step to fw-rollout job
- add preflight to check mgmt VLAN accessibility
- add GPU microcode compatibility matrix to orchestration
- run a simulated rollback drill next week
maria: cost takeaway: add guardrail to pause wide rollouts when any node returns non-200 from SecureBoot endpoint; saves hours of downtime.
alex: thanks team. I'll update the firmware bundle docs with vendor-specific Redfish commands and HSM integration notes.
sasha: closing: nodes back up, incident INC-20260317-3 will be updated with timeline and RCA. we'll schedule a follow-up next week for a safer global rollout. :thumbsup:
